reviews.comment: All 8 checklist items pass; install-activity-hook is idempotent, preserves unrelated PostToolUse entries, and the dashboard surfaces clear empty-states for hook-missing/settings-missing/both-missing plus an Engine: off chip when config disables. Non-blocking notes: dead-code mkdir, detectActivityHookStatus untested directly, settings-missing copy is awkward, intent comment missing for the .local.json-only writer behaviour.
install-activity-hook does not respect activityEngine.enabled=false; init does. Make the subcommand match init's guard before merge.

fix.comment: install-activity-hook now refuses when activityEngine.enabled=false (matching init's guard); --force escape hatch added; two new tests cover refusal and force-override.

reviews.comment: Round-2 blocker resolved: install-activity-hook now respects activityEngine.enabled and refuses (with --force escape) when disabled. Two new smoke tests cover refusal + override. No scope creep; round-1 non-blocking notes deferred.

Activity panel stays empty when hookStatus is ok but events haven't flowed (Claude Code session was started before insight-flow init). Need a 'waiting for activity / restart your Claude Code session' empty-state in dashboard.ts renderActivityEmptyState.
